## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r, load packages and working directory}

# data import and database management 
# reading files, reshaping data, and efficient data handling 

#######################################################

library(readxl) # import excel spreadsheets
library(data.table) #quick manipulation of large datasets
library(stringr) # text and string processing 
library(lubridate) # data and time handling 
library(writexl) # exports editted databases into excel files

#######################################################

# General data science workflow 
# Collection of packages for data manipulation and plotting

#######################################################

library(tidyverse)

#######################################################

#Statistical analyses and mixed models 
# Hypothesis testing, summaries, and model fitting 

#######################################################

library(gt) # displaying formatted tables for statistics 
library(rstatix) # statistical tests and assumption checking
library(lmerTest) # p-values and tests for lme4 models 
library(lme4) # linear and generalized mixed-effects models
library(ggeffects) # predicted values and marginal effects 

#######################################################

# Data visualization 
# Plot creation, figure assembly, and publication formatting 

#######################################################

library(patchwork) #comvine ggplots into multi-panel figures
library(cowplot) # figure arrangement and plot annotations
library(rcartocolor) # color palettes
library(ggh4x) # advanced ggplot extensions
library(scales) # axis labels, formatting, and scaling 

#######################################################
# Spatial data and mapping 
# GIS data handling and map visualization
#######################################################

library(sf) #spatial vector data
library(ggmap) #basemaps and geographic visualization
library(ggspatial) #spatial annotations and map elements
library(leaflet) #interactive web maps

#######################################################

#Tables and report outputs 
# Interactive tables and report presentation 

#######################################################

library(reactable) #interactive tables for reports

#######################################################
# R markdown and document rendering 
# PDF generation and LaTeX support 
#######################################################

library(tinytex) #LaTeX engine for PDF knitting



```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}

plot_data_noG2_elev <- elev_z_flux %>%
  filter(!(Site == "GiantMarsh" & Tran == "2"))

master_thesis_noG2 = readr::write_csv(plot_data_noG2, "C:\\Users\\savan\\OneDrive - San Francisco State University\\ProjectData\\GitHub\\DepositionSFB\\data\\master_thesis_noG2.csv")


master_thesis_noG2_elev = readr::write_csv(plot_data_noG2_elev, "C:\\Users\\savan\\OneDrive - San Francisco State University\\ProjectData\\GitHub\\DepositionSFB\\data\\master_thesis_noG2_elev.csv")


# no site G 

plot_data_noG_elev <- elev_z_flux %>%
  filter(!(Site == "GiantMarsh"))

master_thesis_noG = readr::write_csv(plot_data_noG, "C:\\Users\\savan\\OneDrive - San Francisco State University\\ProjectData\\GitHub\\DepositionSFB\\data\\master_thesis_noG.csv")


master_thesis_noG_elev = readr::write_csv(plot_data_noG_elev, "C:\\Users\\savan\\OneDrive - San Francisco State University\\ProjectData\\GitHub\\DepositionSFB\\data\\master_thesis_noG_elev.csv")
```

```{r}

# tier 1 no flagged data at all, still takes out G2 and keeps zstar data
master_tier1 <- master_thesis_noG2_elev %>%
  filter(!(Master_Flag == "Review"))

master_tier1 = readr::write_csv(master_tier1, "C:\\Users\\savan\\OneDrive - San Francisco State University\\ProjectData\\GitHub\\DepositionSFB\\data\\master_tier1.csv")

#tier 1.5 no flagged data at all, incl. all sites 
master_tier1.5 <- elev_z_flux %>% 
  filter(!(Master_Flag == "Review"))

master_tier1.5 = readr::write_csv(master_tier1.5, "C:\\Users\\savan\\OneDrive - San Francisco State University\\ProjectData\\GitHub\\DepositionSFB\\data\\master_tier1.5.csv")

# tier 2 no data flags for big biological, negative value, and flood observ
master_tier2 <- master_thesis_noG2_elev %>%
  filter(!(BigBio_Obsv == "1"), !(NegValue_Num == "1"), !(Flood_Obsv == "1"))

master_tier2 = readr::write_csv(master_tier2, "C:\\Users\\savan\\OneDrive - San Francisco State University\\ProjectData\\GitHub\\DepositionSFB\\data\\master_tier2.csv")

# tier 3 no data flags for big biological, negative value, and flood observ incl. all sites
master_tier3 <- elev_z_flux %>% 
  filter(!(BigBio_Obsv == "1"), !(NegValue_Num == "1"), !(Flood_Obsv == "1"))

master_tier3 = readr::write_csv(master_tier3, "C:\\Users\\savan\\OneDrive - San Francisco State University\\ProjectData\\GitHub\\DepositionSFB\\data\\master_tier3.csv")

# tier 4 no data flags for biological, negative value, and flood observ take out all G 

master_tier4 <- plot_data_noG_elev %>% 
  filter(!(BigBio_Obsv == "1"), !(NegValue_Num == "1"), !(Flood_Obsv == "1"))

master_tier4 = readr::write_csv(master_tier4, "C:\\Users\\savan\\OneDrive - San Francisco State University\\ProjectData\\GitHub\\DepositionSFB\\data\\master_tier4.csv")

 



```

```{r, statistics, tier 1}

# general summary 

general_summary_tier1 <- master_tier1 %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    Mean = round(mean(Flux, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    SD = round(sd(Flux, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    Median = round(median(Flux, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    Min = round(min(Flux, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    Max = round(max(Flux, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    SE = round(sd(Flux, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(dplyr::n()), 3)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    CI95_Lower = round(Mean - qt(0.975, n - 1) * SE, 3),
    CI95_Upper = round(Mean + qt(0.975, n - 1) * SE, 3)
  )

general_summary_tier1

# Phenological Summary

phen_summary_tier1 <- master_tier1 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Phen_Period) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    Mean = round(mean(Flux, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    SD = round(sd(Flux, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    Median = round(median(Flux, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    Min = round(min(Flux, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    Max = round(max(Flux, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    SE = round(sd(Flux, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(dplyr::n()), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

phen_summary_tier1


# site summary 

site_summary_tier1 <- master_tier1 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Site) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    Mean = round(mean(Flux, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    SD = round(sd(Flux, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    Median = round(median(Flux, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    Min = round(min(Flux, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    Max = round(max(Flux, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    SE = round(sd(Flux, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(dplyr::n()), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
site_summary_tier1

# Date removed from field summary 

phase_summary_tier1 <- master_tier1 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Date.removed.from.field) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    Mean = round(mean(Flux, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    SD = round(sd(Flux, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    Median = round(median(Flux, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    Min = round(min(Flux, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    Max = round(max(Flux, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    SE = round(sd(Flux, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(dplyr::n()), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
phase_summary_tier1


```

```{r, tier 1 plots}


sed_basic_tier1= ggplot(master_tier1, aes(x = Flux)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = expression(Flux~(g/m^2/day)), y = "Count") 

sed_basic_tier1

# Deposition by Edge Type 

sed_edge_tier1= ggplot(master_tier1, aes(x = marsh_edge_type, y = Flux)) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Marsh Edge Type", y = expression(Flux~(g/m^2/day))) 

sed_edge_tier1


# Deposition by Elevation (do this later once you've figured out z*) 

sed_z_tier1= ggplot(master_tier1, aes(x = z_star, y = Flux, color = marsh_edge_type)) +
geom_boxplot() + 
geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5) +
 theme_minimal() +
labs(x = "z*", y = expression(Flux~(g/m^2/day))) 

sed_z_tier1

# Deposition by Distance from Marsh Edge 

sed_dist_edge_tier1= ggplot(master_tier1, aes(x = Dist, y = Flux, color = marsh_edge_type)) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Distance from the Marsh Edge (m) ", y = expression(Flux~(g/m^2/day))) 

sed_dist_edge_tier1

# Deposition by Phenological Time

sed_time_tier1= ggplot(master_tier1, aes(x = Phen_Period, y = Flux)) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Phenological Period ", y = expression(Flux~(g/m^2/day))) 

sed_time_tier1


# Deposition by Marsh Area

sed_edge_area_tier1= ggplot(master_tier1, aes(x = Marsh_Area, y = Flux, color = marsh_edge_type)) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Marsh Area ", y = expression(Flux~(g/m^2/day))) 

sed_edge_area_tier1


# Deposition by Phenological Time by Site

sed_site_time_tier1= ggplot(master_tier1, aes(x = Phen_Period, y = Flux, color = Site)) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Phenological Period ", y = expression(Flux~(g/m^2/day))) 

sed_site_time_tier1


# Deposition by Marsh Area by Site

sed_site_area_tier1= ggplot(master_tier1, aes(x = Marsh_Area, y = Flux, color = Site)) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Marsh Area ", y = expression(Flux~(g/m^2/day))) 

sed_site_area_tier1


# Deposition by Date removed from field by Site

sed_phase_site_tier1= ggplot(master_tier1, aes(x = Date.removed.from.field, y = Flux, color = Site)) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Date removed from field ", y = expression(Flux~(g/m^2/day))) 

sed_phase_site_tier1

# Deposition by Date removed from field by Site (log)

sed_phase_site_log_tier1 = ggplot(master_tier1, aes(x = Date.removed.from.field, y = Flux, color = Site)) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Date removed from field ", y = expression(Flux~(g/m^2/day)))

# Deposition by Date removed from field by Marsh Edge Type

sed_phase_edge_tier1= ggplot(master_tier1, aes(x = Date.removed.from.field, y = Flux, color = marsh_edge_type)) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Marsh Edge Type ", y = expression(Flux~(g/m^2/day))) 
sed_phase_edge_tier1


# Deposition by Date removed from field Across Marsh Area

sed_phase_area_tier1= ggplot(master_tier1, aes(x = Marsh_Area, y = Flux, color = Date.removed.from.field)) +
  facet_wrap(~Site) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Marsh Area ", y = expression(Flux~(g/m^2/day))
  ) 

sed_phase_area_tier1
```

```{r}
# =================================================================
# Consolidated RQ plotting function
# Replaces 4 near-identical code blocks (tier1.5 / tier2 / tier3 / tier4)
# =================================================================

make_rq_plots <- function(df, tier_label) {
  
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Collection Interval Consistency
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  data_intervals <- df %>%
    mutate(interval_days = as.numeric(difftime(Date.removed.from.field, Date.placed.in.field, units = "days"))) %>%
    distinct(Tran, Date.removed.from.field, interval_days)
  
  p_interval <- ggplot(data_intervals, aes(x = Date.removed.from.field, y = interval_days, color = Tran)) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 30, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
    labs(
      title = paste("Collection Interval Length Over Time —", tier_label),
      subtitle = "Dashed line = nominal 30-day target",
      x = "Time", y = "Interval Length (days)", color = "Transect"
    ) +
    scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %Y", date_breaks = "3 months") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
  print(summary(data_intervals$interval_days))
  
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # RQ1: Flux by Marsh Edge Type
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  p_edge <- ggplot(df, aes(x = marsh_edge_type, y = Flux, fill = marsh_edge_type)) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 0.4, trim = FALSE) +
    geom_jitter(aes(color = Site), width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Sediment Flux by Marsh Edge Type —", tier_label),
      subtitle = "Points colored by Site — check if the two sites within each type agree",
      x = NULL, y = "Flux (g/m2/day)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")
  
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # RQ1: Flux vs. Distance Along Transect (Inundation Gradient)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  p_dist <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Dist, y = Flux, color = Tran, group = Tran)) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_smooth(mapping = aes(group = marsh_edge_type),
                method = "loess", color = "black",
                linewidth = 1, se = TRUE, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    facet_wrap(~ marsh_edge_type) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Sediment Flux vs Distance Along Transect —", tier_label),
      subtitle = "Black smooth = overall trend within edge type; colored lines = individual transects",
      x = "Distance Along Transect (m)", y = "Flux (g/m2/day)", color = "Transect"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # RQ2: Flux Over Time, by Edge Type
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  p_time <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Date.removed.from.field, y = Flux, color = Tran, group = Tran)) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_smooth(mapping = aes(group = marsh_edge_type),
                method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black",
                linewidth = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    facet_wrap(~ marsh_edge_type) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Sediment Flux Over Time by Transect —", tier_label),
      subtitle = "A flat black trend line within a panel supports a constant-flux hypothesis",
      x = "Time (Year-Month)", y = "Flux (g/m2/day)", color = "Transect"
    ) +
    scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %Y", date_breaks = "3 months") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # RQ2: Per-Transect Slope Summary
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  slopes_by_transect <- df %>%
    group_by(Tran, marsh_edge_type) %>%
    summarize(
      slope = coef(lm(Flux ~ as.numeric(Date.removed.from.field)))[2],
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  p_slope <- ggplot(slopes_by_transect, aes(x = marsh_edge_type, y = slope, color = marsh_edge_type)) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.1, size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
    labs(
      title = paste("Flux Trend Over Time, by Transect —", tier_label),
      subtitle = "Values near zero support the constant-flux hypothesis",
      x = NULL, y = "Slope of Flux vs Time (per day)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Seasonality Check (Exploratory)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  p_season <- ggplot(df, aes(x = factor(month(Date.removed.from.field)), y = Flux, fill = marsh_edge_type)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Sediment Flux by Month (Pooled Across Years) —", tier_label),
      subtitle = "Checks whether flux varies seasonally, independent of longer-term trend",
      x = "Month", y = "Flux (g/m2/day)", fill = "Edge Type"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # RQ3: Flux by Site
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------
  p_site <- ggplot(df, aes(x = reorder(Site, Flux, median), y = Flux, fill = marsh_edge_type)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Sediment Flux by Site —", tier_label),
      subtitle = "Sorted by median — flags whether MorphType groups sites as expected",
      x = "Site", y = "Flux (g/m2/day)", fill = "Edge Type"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    coord_flip()
  
  # Return everything as a named list so you can access/print/save individually,
  # e.g. tier2_plots$p_edge, or walk(tier2_plots, print)
  list(
    interval = p_interval,
    edge     = p_edge,
    dist     = p_dist,
    time     = p_time,
    slope    = p_slope,
    season   = p_season,
    site     = p_site,
    slopes_by_transect = slopes_by_transect  # data, not a plot, kept for reference/export
  )
}

# =================================================================
# Per-tier calls — put each of these in its own {r} chunk in the .qmd
# so they render as separate code blocks (e.g. for chunk-level
# captions, fig.cap, or fig.height options per tier).
# =================================================================

# ---- {r, tier1.5 RQ plots} -------------------------------------
tier1.5_plots <- make_rq_plots(master_tier1.5, "tier1.5")
tier1.5_plots$interval
tier1.5_plots$edge
tier1.5_plots$dist
tier1.5_plots$time
tier1.5_plots$slope
tier1.5_plots$season
```
